title: Chapter 1375
text:
In the conference room of the command center, the highest commanders, the chiefs of the various branches, and the Beyond Grade As were gathered.

On the tactical simulation table, a three-dimensional star map of the intercepting circle floated. Simon stood beside it and kept fiddling with the star map. He used his fingers to draw tactical symbols and kept explaining the current situation.

"… According to Black Star's intelligence, the World Tree has gathered a 200 billion super-large army this time and is suspected to be launching a general attack. This is the map of our various branches and the distribution of the wormhole support base stations. It can be seen that the area where our troops are currently mobilized the fastest is between A-1075C and N-0744J. If the World Tree attacks this line of defense, all of our main defense forces can gather and descend as quickly as possible. However, the gathering speed of the other lines of defense is slightly slower. This slight difference in time may become a breakthrough point, causing the World Tree to break through the first and second layers of defense with a huge number of troops. They will enter the strategic depth zone and the wormhole support base station distribution zone, threatening the third layer and the rest of the lines of defense. This will create a vicious cycle, and we will be in a passive position … "

The expressions of the upper echelons were solemn. The pressure of a 200 billion fleet was much higher than the previous three attacks. Any factor could become a breakthrough point for the other party.

"I think that the other party will not repeat the same mistake this time after experiencing the previous three failures. They will most likely change their attack method and will not immediately charge in."

"Our construction time is still too short. Not only does the World Tree want to break through the blockade, but it also wants to destroy our fortifications in one go. Only by removing the intercepting circle that we are constantly advancing can they stabilize the jump point and build a bridgehead to invade our territory."

"We need more reinforcements from the rear. It's best to increase the distance between the first two lines of defense and the rear lines of defense to prevent the other party from breaking through the blockade."

The commanders of the troops expressed their opinions one after another, and the group discussed intensely.

As for the Beyond Grade As, they just sat by the side and listened, not participating at all.

However, after the upper echelons discussed for a while, Simon turned around and asked Han Xiao.

"Black Star, what do you think?"

"You guys can decide on this matter. I have no objections."

Han Xiao shook his head, indicating that professional matters should be done by professionals.

However, he paused for a moment before adding, "However, there's a high chance that the World Tree has sensed the direction of the information leak. The authenticity of the information I obtained is doubtful, and it might be a trick deliberately released by the World Tree. This risk has to be considered."

Simon took a deep breath. "I understand that, but even if we cannot confirm whether the intelligence is true or false, we have to be prepared to deal with a fleet of two hundred billion. Even if there is only one percent or one in a thousand chance that it is true, we have to be prepared. Otherwise, the consequences will be dire."

"Indeed." Han Xiao nodded. If it was true and he did not take precautions in advance, there was an eighty percent chance that the World Tree would break through his defenses and kill him.

Destiny's Child had also monitored the first two attacks. Han Xiao had also retained his suspicions, but in the end, it was proven that the information was correct. However, this did not make him feel at ease. Instead, it made him even more vigilant.

If the World Tree had deliberately revealed the information about the first two attacks to try to reduce their wariness, then it must be holding back a big move and sending out fake information at the critical moment. However, there was no way to know what the World Tree was planning.

"Fortunately, I got a new observation device from the First Sanctum and gave it to the three Universal Civilizations. The World Tree can't act secretly here like before. Any movement will be discovered."

Han Xiaoxin thought to himself.

Ever since the three Universal Civilizations applied the special over-the-horizon detection technology he had provided to the battle, their reliance on Destiny's Child's surveillance channel had decreased greatly. Even if the World Tree had any plans, it could not be carried out secretly, and the risk was greatly reduced.

The meeting lasted for a long time before the commanders left with heavy hearts.

Han Xiao and the others also left the meeting room and returned to their residence.

On the way, Kasuyi squeezed through the crowd and came to Han Xiao's side.

"The World Tree did not send any high-level combatants in the first two attacks. This time, they suddenly launched an all-out attack. Do you think they have found a way to restrict Aurora?"

Han Xiao glanced at him. Before he could say anything, Sun Hunter jumped from Han Xiao's shoulder to Kasuyi's head and said in a muffled voice,

"Heh, they might be planning to ignore us high-level combatants and purely use their troops to attack the defense line."

"Ignore us? It's not impossible as long as they're willing to bear the risk of a local battle. After all, no matter how powerful we are, we won't be able to have a fundamental impact in a war of this scale. At most, we'll open up some opportunities, "Kasuyi pondered.

Seeing that the two of them were chatting, Han Xiao gave up on replying and turned to look at Ames.

"Hmm? Why are you looking at me? "Ames raised her brows.

"Are you afraid that the enemy will take out 200 billion fleets?" Han Xiao asked casually.

"There's nothing to be afraid of." Ames shook her head. In the past few months, she had participated in the first two attacks of the World Tree and now had war experience.

"It's different this time. The World Tree might send out high-level combatants. You haven't participated in the first large-scale battle and haven't fought with the World Tree experts. They're very difficult to deal with."

"It's a good opportunity to broaden my horizons." Ames's expression was calm.

"Don't underestimate them. The intensity of a Beyond Grade A battle is not something that can be compared to the previous two battles with conventional fleets. I suggest you follow Milizaus." Han Xiao pointed at the old dragon.

"Why should I follow him?" Ames was curious.

"He's so big. If you hide on him, they won't be able to hit you. If necessary, you can even throw his body out with your force field to help you block the attacks."

Han Xiao shrugged.

"… You know I can hear you, right?"

Milizaus's incarnation could not help but turn around and look at him helplessly.

"I just want you to hear me. My nickname is the Dragon Emperor. It's reasonable for me to sit on you, right?" Han Xiao curled his lips.

"These words sound familiar. Have you told me this before?"

Milizaus snorted disapprovingly through his nostrils.

Han Xiao spread his hands. "Don't you think this strategy is very reliable?"

"I don't think so at all. Furthermore, my body has already shrunk a lot, so I won't be used as a target by the enemy. This plan is definitely useless." Milizaus was very calm. A person who had successfully lost weight was so unyielding.

"Then recover your body size. You have such a huge body, but you don't protect your teammates. This is a waste!"

You're dreaming … Milizaus rolled his eyes and ignored Han Xiao.

The group was not frightened by the possible large-scale battle and returned to their residence while chatting and laughing.

Han Xiao closed the door. His smile quickly disappeared, and he frowned slightly.

He had a feeling that the World Tree was going to use high-level combatants this time, and the Subduing Tree King should not have revived yet. There was probably a new Tree King coming this time.

Among the five Great Tree Kings, only the Subduing Tree King's ability was the simplest and most violent. The other Tree Kings were all flowery. No matter who it was, they would only be more difficult to deal with than the Subduing Tree King.

…

At the same time, in the Flickering World, on a desolate planet in the Black Star Corps territory.

Rumble —

Two blurry figures flashed across the desolate land like meteors, constantly colliding with each other. Every time, they were on the verge of exploding, creating intense shockwaves and leaving huge craters on the ground.

Suddenly, the two figures came to a halt, revealing their appearances. One was Lothaire, and the other was Karlot, who was receiving instruction.

Lothaire spun the dagger with his fingers and kept it in the scabbard at his waist. "Your strength has increased again. You can already withstand my current strength. In the next combat training, I will release more combat strength and continue to squeeze out your potential."

"Alright, I'll train hard." Karlot's fists collided with each other, causing sparks to fly. His face was filled with determination.

He had applied to go to the frontlines to fight against the enemies more than once, but he had always been rejected by Black Star. He knew that this was because Han Xiao valued his potential and was giving him time to grow under the pressure at the frontlines.

Carrott understood that his most important task was to focus on training and grow to the point where he could go to the frontlines to help Han Xiao as soon as possible. Therefore, after the war broke out, he took the initiative to train every day.

"Hmm, with this speed, it's only a matter of time before you become a Beyond Grade A …"

Although Lothaire said this, he was secretly muttering in his heart.

During the days of training Carrott, he realized that Carrott's improvement was extraordinary. Furthermore, his growth speed did not slow down because of the increase in his strength. Instead, it became faster and faster. It was as if there was no bottleneck, and his improvement every day was visible to the naked eye.

Lothaire was originally curious about why Han Xiao valued Carrott, but now, he no longer had any doubts, only deep surprise.

There's actually such a martial arts genius in this world? How did Black Star discover him!

…

World Tree Territory, Tree King Palace.

On the five thrones sat two figures. One was the Heart Tree King, and the other was the Fortitude Tree King, who was wrapped in heavy armor. Below the two Tree Kings stood many Executive Officers. Some of the people who had died in battle had already been revived.

"Release the information?"

"It has already been displayed through the Foreseers," Tedrian replied with his head lowered.

"Hmm, I hope their attention is all on this."

Heart Tree King rubbed the armrest and nodded slowly.

Tedrian continued, "In the previous few attacks, we have already calculated the approximate structure of the interception circle, as well as the number of troops stationed and the limit of follow-up support. This time, we will increase our advantage in numbers and should be able to break through the interception circle in one go. At the very least, we will be able to clear their space anchor orbit …"

Hearing this, Heart Tree King casually nodded and did not have any intention of saying anything else. He waved his hand and let the Executive Officers leave.

Very soon, only the two Tree Kings were left in the palace.

Fortitude Tree King turned his head slightly and seemed to be looking at Heart Tree King from the corner of his eye hidden behind the mechanical suit's mask.

"You've already decided to take action personally? Is this your intention for urging me to reveal myself? "

"Hmm, only I can deal with that recovery-type Esper easily, and that Universal Treasure can only unleash its greatest power in my hands … If I die there, you will be in charge of the matters here for the time being," Heart Tree King said calmly.

"How long until the Subduing Tree King revives?" Fortitude Tree King frowned.

"Although I water him every day, there's still some time." Heart Tree King waved his hand.

Fortitude Tree King was silent for a while before saying with a deep voice, "In that case, bring my Lord's Avatar, Apostle Weapons, and mechanical army over."

"You plan to save my life?"

"If I let you live to preside over the matters here, I can continue to stay comfortably in the mother tree and absorb nutrients," Fortitude Tree King said coldly.

Heart Tree King shook his head. "The civilization this time is very strong. You will have to participate in the battle sooner or later."

"We'll talk about it when the time comes."

After saying that, Fortitude Tree King's body merged into the tree crown throne and disappeared.

Seeing this, Heart Tree King felt a little helpless.

No matter how hardworking they were in the past, after being chosen as the Tree King, they would all become lazier and lazier. They would not move if they could, especially Fortitude Tree King, who was a Mechanic.

He still remembered that this guy was a research and development maniac before he became the Tree King. Now, not to mention research and development, he could not even be bothered to build machinery.

In comparison, Heart Tree King preferred the Subduing Tree King. He could make him work with just a few words. He was simply a clear stream among the Tree Kings, the best tool in the eyes of the other four.

(End of Chapter)
